newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT IN FIRST TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT IN FIRST TEST.

text.p: Australia won the toss and decided to bat in the first cricket test against England at Edgbaston starting on Thursday.
England - Michael Atherton (captain), Mark Butcher, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Mark Ealham, Darren Gough, Robert Croft, Andrew Caddick, Devon Malcolm.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Greg Blewett, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Mike Kasprowicz, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath.
